newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Fire destroys Choongnam dyeing plant.
newsitem.headline: Fire destroys Choongnam dyeing plant.

text.p: Fire destroyed the dyeing plant at Choongnam Spinning Co, South Korea's largest cotton spinning company, Choongnam officials said on Tuesday.

"The fire has burnt down the whole dyeing factory," said one official. "Since the factory is the only dyeing plant we have, we are expecting some impact on our production," she said, without giving details.

Fire raged for four hours on Monday night causing damage estimated at 12 billion won. Police are investigating. Choongnam produces 23,000 tonnes of cotton and wool yarn each year and employs about 3,000 workers.
